contexts.text: With the evil, corporeal and worldly things can be lulled, and then they can be elevated into a certain heavenly [state].
Unless the evil were separated from the good, the evil would inflict injury on the good...

The Holy itself proceeding from the Divine Human is what separates the evil from the good; for the evil so fear and abhor the Holy of the Lord, that they cannot come near it, but flee far away... into their Hells.
Sodom = the evil, especially those who are within the Church...
Lot sitting in the gate of Sodom = those who are in the good of charity... who are among the evil, but separated from them... not as to civil society, but as to spiritual life.
The evil are as far from receiving faith... as Hell is from Heaven... Explained.
That before the Judgment upon the evil, they who are in the affection of truth are to be saved. Signified, Explained.
Children can be loved by the evil (but not a married partner).
There is only one life, which is that of the Lord, and which flows in and causes... both the good and the evil to live.

This capacity of being able to understand what good and truth are... exists with the evil as well as the good; nay, with the evil it is sometimes more acute; but with this difference, that with the evil there is not any affection of truth for the sake of life...
To render aid to the evil is to do evil to many... AC 4992:end.
The evil can know (these truths); nay, can be in the persuasion that it is so...
The evil... cannot be in the company of the good (there); but when they approach them seem to themselves not to be able to breathe...
Hence it is that the evil cannot stay in the Societies of the good, nor the good in the Societies of the evil.
Through the outermost plane, which appears like conscience, and yet is not, the Lord rules... the evil...
The evil; nay, the worst, say (that they believe in a Supreme Being).
Hence it was, that the evil as well as the good... could represent (Divine things).
That the evil also receive the life which is from the Lord. Explained.
Not knowing that (confidence and trust) are possible also with the evil.
The life of the evil does indeed appear to them as life; but it is the life which is called spiritual death. (Explained.)
(To confirm any dogma that is once received) is what the evil can do more skillfully than the good.
Every Spirit and Angel sees... the evil on the left; and this to whatever quarter he turns...

Good is done to (the evil) if they are punished according to the laws, because by punishments they are amended... But they who are in (merely) natural truth... benefit everyone who excites compassion... and for the most part, the evil more than the good...
The spiritual man thinks that good is not to be done to... the evil.
The spiritual man thinks... that to do good to an evil (person) is to do evil to the neighbour...
The fiery vitality with the evil is such that...
Mercy sometimes appears with the evil who are in no charity... but it is the mercy of friendship for the sake of self...
They who had benefited the evil equally with the upright... AC 6405:2.
a. 3. These truths have no life; as is evident from the fact, that an evil man, even the worst, is equally well able to know the truths of faith...

They saw the evil exalted to honours... Wherefore such things are given to the evil... Moreover, the Lord provides His ends through the evil equally as through the good; for the Lord moves the evil to do good to the neighbour... through their own loves; for the evil want to be in eminence... and therefore want to seem upright and zealous; and from this desire... are more strongly excited to do such things than the upright. The evil are also permitted to believe that all things are of their own prudence... and successes are therefore given to them, which... excite them still more.
The Lord continually flows in with good and truth... but with the evil this influx... is resisted and rejected, or is perverted or suffocated...
From the evil (there), are taken away all their intuitions of what is honest and good for the sake of gain...
With the evil there is influx from Hell.
They know that good and truth... have a secret power of attracting minds, even those of the evil.
The evil (there) forming plans. Signified.
The order of truth Divine for the evil who are being damned... is that of truth Divine separated from Divine good, because they have not received Divine good...
Fear is a common bond, with both those who are upright and with those who are evil. Explained.
When the evil come into the other life, and when external bonds are taken away... they are like wild beasts...

When the evil first come there, they have good Spirits and Angels adjoined to them, as when they lived in the body; for even evil men have Angels with them... but the Angels and good Spirits recede from them by degrees; and as they recede they become less and less rational. Signified.
As the non-attention to Divine things with the evil is from the resistance of the will, this also is signified.
Among the more delightful things with the evil is to scatter falsities, to confirm them, to ridicule truths, and especially to seduce others.
There is no enlightenment... with the evil who are represented by Pharaoh and the Egyptians, but elevation to attention.
Sometimes truth from the Divine appears to the evil, and this by means of the presence of an Angel near them... but it affects their exteriors only...
There would be (sores) on every evil man, unless, so long as he is in the world, he was in a state of receiving the good and truth of faith...
It (here) treats of the good and truth which are reserved by the Lord even with the evil...
There is indeed a communication of the evil, even those who are in Hell, with Heaven. Explained.

The good and truth stored up and reserved in the interiors with the evil effects nothing, except to enable them to reason, and to think and speak from the Sensuous, and thus to confirm falsity, and defend evil.
That the evil may Know that they are in evil; and that the good may be enlightened concerning the state of those who live evilly within the Church. Signified. AC 7795.
That the scientifics of truth and good taken from the evil who had been of the Church are to be bestowed on the good who are thence. Signified. AC 7969.
The evil who are in Hell have no respect for the Divine except that of fear.
That the nature of the difference between those who are in evil and those who are in good is known. Signified.
That before they are... sent into Hell the evil undergo so many states, is entirely unknown...
These regions are occupied when the evil are increased in the world...
The effect of the Lord's presence with the evil.
When the reins are slackened, the evil are so audacious and impudent as to suppose themselves able to destroy Heaven. Signified.
It is believed that an evil man is in a state of peace when he is in gladness and tranquillity from the fact that all things succeed with him...
When they see many of the evil abound in honours and riches... AC 10775. DP 216:2. DP 217.
The penetration of truth Divine with the evil. Signified.
Truth Divine through the Heavens is such that it perfects the good, but destroys the evil... The reason it destroys the evil, is that they do not receive the Divine good which is therein.
When the Lord protects the good against the evil, it appears like hostility and anger. Illustrated.

The love of evil, that is, the love of self and the love of the world, constitute the fire of life with an evil man and with a Spirit of Hell; and the love of falsity and the faith of falsity constitute the lumen of life with them. Signified.
The confidence which in an eminent sense is called faith, appears like spiritual confidence even with the evil when they are in dangers and sickness...

Truths do indeed exist with the evil... but they are not commingled with the falsities from evil with them so long as they are only in the memory, and serve as means to evil; for so long they are devoid of life...

All in the other life, both the evil and the good, can understand what is true and false, and what is good and evil; but the evil, although they understand truth and good, still do not want to understand it... and therefore, when they are left to themselves, they relapse into the falsities of their evil, and abhor the truth and good which they had understood. The case is the same with such in the world...
Termination from good lest they should be approached and injured by the evil. Signified.
This is the reason why machinations and cunning succeed with the evil... AC 10777.
When they came, the good were separated from the evil... The evil to the left... who were ordered according to the quality of the evil with them... and the evil were cast into Hell.
They said that the lower parts of that earth are inhabited by both the good and the evil, but they are carefully separated, in order that the evil may be ruled by the Lord by means of the good.

In that descent the good were in like manner separated from the evil... for by various arts and cunning, the evil had introduced themselves into the abodes of the good, and had infested them; which was the reason of this visitation.
The evil who are outside of Heaven are tormented at His presence.
When looked at by the Angels, a man as to his spirit... if evil appears as a monster, ugly according to his evil.
Thus an evil man is conjoined with Hell.

After death... the evil are at once bound to the infernal Society in which they had been in the world as to their reigning love... Yet although thus distinct, still, in the World of Spirits they come together... when they desire...
(The nature acquired by the evil cannot be amended after death by means of the understanding of truth.)
The evil do not see the stone at the two ways, and fall over it...
(Thus) the evil equally with the good lead the same life in externals...

With the evil, the internal is in the world and its light, and the external is also in the same; and therefore they see nothing from the light of Heaven, but only from the light of the world... Hence it is that the things of Heaven are in thick darkness with them, and the things of the world are in light. (Thus)... the evil have no internal man, but only an external one.
The Lord rules the world by means of the evil, leading them by means of their Own loves... References.
The evil equally with the good can... perform uses, because they regard honours and gains as rewards... References.

The Lord does not inflict destruction on anyone; but only protects His own, and withdraws them from communication with the evil; and when they are withdrawn, the evil come into their concupiscences, and, from them, rush into wickednesses of every kind.
In these two faculties is the Lord with every man, both good and evil... Hence it is that every man, both good and evil, lives to eternity. DP 96:5. DP 96:7.

An evil man, although at heart he denies the Divine things of the Church, can still understand them, and can also speak and preach them, and confirm them learnedly in writing; but when he is left to himself, he thinks from his infernal love against them, and denies them.
An evil man, equally as a good one, enjoys these two faculties. General article.
An evil man abuses these faculties to confirm evils and falsities. General article.

As an evil man... has rationality and freedom, an evil man... can understand truth and do good, but he cannot do so from freedom according to reason... because an evil man is in the delight of the love of evil... and therefore the truth which an evil man understands, and the good which he does, are not appropriated to him... DP 89:end.
Hence it is that an evil man... can understand; and hence he has, in potency, the will of good and the understanding of truth.
Under Concupiscence, see this reference.
That the life of the evil is also from the same origin...
It follows, that dignities and riches... with the evil are curses.

The reason the evil... are exalted to honours and advanced to wealth, is that the evil equally with the good, do uses; but the evil, for the sake of the honours and gains for their own person... The evil regard the honours and gains for the person as the principal causes, and those of the business as the instrumental causes. DP 250:3.
It is this good by means of which every man, even an evil one, is led by the Lord.
By these means the Lord leads the evil; but only from doing those things; not from thinking and willing them.
The evil can perform uses... from a stronger fire (than the good), because they regard themselves in the uses... DP 252:2.
The Divine Providence is equally with the evil as with the good. General article. DP 287.
It follows that the Lord rules the veriest singulars, even with an evil man...
For an evil man is a Hell in the least form...
The evil who are in the world the Lord rules in Hell as to interiors, but not as to exteriors. General article.
Explained. DP 307:3.
With the evil, the spirals turn backwards... towards Hell, and receive influx thence.
(Thus) the Divine Love is in every evil man (also)... It appears as if it recedes from the evil; but the evil recede; nevertheless, He leads them from love. Signified. DP 337.
With the evil, the Lord provides by permitting and continually withdrawing from evils...
The Lord provides their places for the evil by permitting and withdrawing.
Exploration by the Lord of the state of life of those who were interiorly evil. Signified.
a. 2. He who has been evil in internals, must also be evil in externals...
Those become such (dumb machines) who are inmostly evil.
With the evil, the internal mind is insane, and the external wise.

The life of God in all fullness is... (also) with evil and impious men... The difference is, that the evil block up the way and close the door to prevent the Lord from entering into the lower things of their mind... The evil block up this influx by means of various concupiscences of the flesh and spiritual defilements... but still the Lord resides in their highest things with all His Divine essence, and gives them the faculty of willing good and of understanding truth...
There is no faith with the evil. General article.

All those are evil who deny the creation of the world by God, and thus deny God... The reason that all such are evil, is that all good... is from God... These are theoretically evil; whereas, those are practically evil who make nothing of the Divine precepts...

With the evil, the internal is in Hell and its light... and their external can be in a like light to that in which the good are... Hence it is that the evil can speak and teach about faith, charity, and God; but not from faith, charity, and God, as the good can.
The internal man with the evil is a satan; and, while he lives in the body, he is in society with them... TCR 455.
(How charity is exercised towards the evil.)

(The idea that charity is to do good to everyone, whether he is good or evil)... Such then benefit equally the evil and the good; and the evil thereby do evils, and thus injure the good. By comparisons.
The friendship of love among the evil, is deadly hatred among them. General article.
This (second) Advent of the Lord exists in order that the evil may be separated from the good... General article.
How the Lord's life is infused also into the evil.
That the Lord's Church is for the most part promoted by the evil.
That there is nothing of life in the evil.
On the nature of the life of the evil.
In that state they never say that [anyone] is evil.
In an external state he could better comprehend that he is evil...
A very prominent example that the evil, and in fact devils, have the gift of understanding truth...
How certain evil ones are reduced into terror for the evils they have perpetrated in the life of the body.
The Lord filled... very many who are in evil... with His Divine in ultimates.
(How goods and truths are removed from the evil there.)
How magical things, and the like, are taken away from the evil.
A characteristic mark of the evil and of the good.
Lest the evil should be injured before the day they were to be rejected. Signified.
When the Divine proceeding... flows in gently, the good are separated from the evil; and when intensely, the evil are rejected. Explained.
Unless the good were separated from the evil, before the evil are cast into Hell, both would perish. Explained.
How the separation of the good from the evil is effected.
a. 2. By means of this influx, the interiors with the evil are opened...
This deflux, when strong, produces one effect with the good, and another with the evil. Explained.

The Divine influx... with the evil, with whom there is no spiritual mind, opens the interiors of their natural mind, where evils and falsities reside, whence they then have an aversion for all the good of Heaven, and hatred against truths, and concupiscence for every crime; hence their separation from the good, and speedy damnation.
Evil in place of good... is signified by, I will sell the land into the hand of the evil ().
It is from this fact that the evil, when no longer in externals, have no terror for evils and falsities; and not even for Hell.

With the evil, there is disturbance of mind and change of state from imminent and visible danger to the life of the body... because the evil regard the life of the body as the principal and final one...
The falsity of those who are in evils, is signified by the seed of the evil ().

Hence it is evident what is the state of those who are evil, and fear neither God nor man; namely, that interiorly with themselves they think evils and falsities, but exteriorly they think and thence speak truths, and also do goods...
All the evil have the animus and cupidity, and consequently the will, to destroy the truths of Heaven and the Church by means of falsities; the reason is, that they are conjoined with Hell...
